description.content:
The operations resource is a mean to send and monitor asynchronous operations to various Oracle Cloud Service Components. The operations consist of items defined in the operationItemDefinitions resource.

Sample for creating a new service instance

   POST /itas/idcs-b613095893a44b0582073eb2edade2de/myservices/api/v1/operations HTTP/1.1
   User-Agent: test/1.0
   Host: host
   Accept: application/json
   Content-Type:application/json

   {
   "operationItems": [
    {
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "requestPayload.name",
          "value": "myServiceName"
        },
        {
          "name": "requestPayload.serviceEntitlementId",
          "value": "500176796"
        },
        {
          "name": "requestPayload.size",
          "value": "CUSTOM"
        },
        {
          "name": "requestPayload.serviceType",
          "value": "IDCS"
        },
        {
          "name": "requestPayload.customAttributes.PickInstanceSize",
          "value": "Identity Cloud Service Basic - Enterprise User- Non-metered - Hosted Named User"
        }
      ],
      "operationItemDefinition": {
        "id": "CIM-IDCS-CUSTOM--CREATE",
        "operationType": "CREATE",
        "canonicalLink": "/itas/idcs-b613095893a44b0582073eb2edade2de/myservices/api/operationItemDefinitions/CIM-IDCS-CUSTOM--CREATE"
      }
    }
   ]
   }
